chunks: And by his chain, from Ali (peace be upon him), from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said:
The callers to prayer will have the longest necks of people on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُونَ: Callers to prayer (those who recite the Adhan)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the callers to prayer having long necks on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the spiritual elevation of the Mu'adhdhin, with 'longest necks' symbolizing both physical prominence and the humility of bearing the divine call. Scholars often interpret this as a reward for those who publicly announce the presence of God, linking their role to the broader theme of testimony and leadership in the community.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-249 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said,
“Those who say the call to prayer will be taller than others on the Resurrection Day.”
